text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(This... freaking... hurts... Can't...
breathe...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (So this... is a senior G1...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what gives?! Where's all the
energy, folks?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Show us your burning passion! Show us
your
burning hearts! Eat some burning
fish!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (What is her deal?! How can...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aggghhh! She's so annoying!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I hate how dumb she is! And how strong
she is in
spite of that! And how much fun
she has running!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aghhh... Come ooon...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've never been so tired in my life,
but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm exhausted. I'm sore. But I think... I
think I
yelled as loud as I could after it
was over.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: By the way, what's our next goal again?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho, obviously.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Golshi...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! You think the war between us
is over
after just one little skirmish?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be kidding. I thought you
said you
were gonna completely
obliterate me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oblit...er...ate?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dumb remarks aside—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You're the dumb one! That's why
I'm gonna
surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I guess we're going into overtime
to decide
who's the strongest. Lookin'
forward to our next
bout.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey. Wait!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What is with her?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Obviously! If I'm gonna do this, I'm
gonna go all
the way!
choice_data_list: So, are you taking on the Tenno Sh...
So, are you going to challenge the...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At 3,200 meters, the spring Tenno Sho is a
long-distance race suited for stayers,
in addition
to attracting some of the
most talented seniors.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
See if I care! I'm done worrying about

complicated stuff!
choice_data_list: It might turn out to be a tough ra...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat Golshi. That's all I need
to think
about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her declaration is so simple and
powerful, it's hard to believe she's the
same runner who fell into
a slump after
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Duh! I mean...
choice_data_list: You can still get so much stronger.
You can still get so much stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make it big! Super big!
